title: Rig Context Receipt
description: Receipt emitted by rig.get_context. Content-light: no file contents, only hashes, paths, counts, and timestamps.

context_id.description: Corresponds to the context_id in the packet.

request_sha256.description: SHA256 of the canonical JSON request.

packet_sha256.description: SHA256 of the canonical JSON output packet.

estimated_tokens.description: Estimated token count of the output packet.

duration_ms.description: Time spent building the context packet in milliseconds.
